'''Toirboggle''' was a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] who worked on an epic poem about [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] called ''[[Honor Amongst Thieves]]''. In order to gain inspiration, he sought membership on a pirate ship captained by pirate [[Olian Okamie]]. He proved to be a capable accountant and even revealed to Okamie that someone had been stealing from him. The Snivvian continued to travel on the pirate ship on the rim of [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]], not participating in the violence but getting into the spirit of things.<ref name="H&R" />
